correspondences.notes: BIDS 1.11.2 has no suffix for diffusion model fits.

brainlife.desc: DIPY PeaksAndMetrics (.pam5, HDF5) file from a CSA or CSD fit: peak directions, values and indices, SH coefficients and GFA.
brainlife.name: neuro/peaks_and_metrics
brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Direction getter for DIPY local and particle filtering tractography.

**Not for:** MRtrix or TractSeg Apps; they need NIfTI FODs or peaks.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 5 Apps, output of 2 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.peaks_and_metrics.json

identifying_risks: NIfTI headers or metadata may carry subject codes or dates
Rare lesions or anomalies can be recognisable in small samples
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 4: participant-level processed diffusion MRI without direct identifiers.
sharing_cautions: Share with coded subject IDs under a data use agreement
Check headers and metadata for identifiers before release
tier_conditions: Tier 1 only as a group-averaged template
Tier 4 if used as features for predicting cognitive or clinical states

intended_use: Direction getter for DIPY local and particle filtering tractography.
not_suitable_for: MRtrix or TractSeg Apps; they need NIfTI FODs or peaks.
